programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: Scott and Bryan are back with a new resort property bursting with potential and an epic challenge unlike any before! Four new talented builder-designer duos are set to take on four empty, dry-walled shells and transform them into breathtaking lakefront retreats. But before tackling their individual lake houses, for the first time ever, the teams are required to pair up and go head-to-head to tackle the neglected and dreary beachfront.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
